IE.title: This child is wearing a halo, and it’s helping treat a severe curve in the spine. 💪 It’s called halo gravity traction. A ring is secured around the head, and a gentle, gradual pull from gravity and weights stretches the spine over time. The idea is to improve how flexible the curve is and, in some cases, to better prepare the spine for surgery. 🦴 Here’s why it’s used: ✅ Severe scoliosis can be stiff, and a gradual stretch may make a later surgery safer and more precise. ✅ Patients can often move around, sit up, and even do daily activities while in traction, depending on the plan. ✅ It’s done under close supervision by a medical team, because every child and every curve is different. It takes patience and courage, especially for a young patient and their family. 🙏 Scoliosis is caught early with regular checks. If you notice uneven shoulders, a tilted waist, or a visible curve in your child’s back, have it evaluated. Have you or someone you love dealt with scoliosis? Share your story below. 👇 In South Florida? See Dr. Abbasi in Delray Beach. Click the link in my bio to schedule an appointment.
IE.author: Dr. David Abbasi, MD

GLOBAL.title: This child is wearing a halo, and it’s helping treat a severe curve in the spine. 💪 It’s called halo gravity traction. A ring is secured around the head, and a gentle, gradual pull from gravity and weights stretches the spine over time. The idea is to improve how flexible the curve is and, in some cases, to better prepare the spine for surgery. 🦴 Here’s why it’s used: ✅ Severe scoliosis can be stiff, and a gradual stretch may make a later surgery safer and more precise. ✅ Patients can often move around, sit up, and even do daily activities while in traction, depending on the plan. ✅ It’s done under close supervision by a medical team, because every child and every curve is different. It takes patience and courage, especially for a young patient and their family. 🙏 Scoliosis is caught early with regular checks. If you notice uneven shoulders, a tilted waist, or a visible curve in your child’s back, have it evaluated. Have you or someone you love dealt with scoliosis? Share your story below. 👇 In South Florida? See Dr. Abbasi in Delray Beach. Click the link in my bio to schedule an appointment.
